prompt: What was the running time of the first cartoon in the series that inspired the name of the Looney Tunes franchise?
answer: The series was Disney’s **_Silly Symphonies_**, whose first cartoon was **_The Skeleton Dance_ (1929)**. Its running time was approximately **5 minutes 30 seconds**.
